purpose: Bind the student sickness demand/friction signal to the shared student_csn product capability and permanent synthetic regressions.

mappings.product_miss: The shared student_csn capability covered CSN weeks and summer study but could not route a student who became sick to the correct first notification path.
mappings.fix_or_guardrail: Keep the same student_csn focus and add topic=sickness. Reuse explicit study context and otherwise ask only the one study-context question that can change the first route. Keep VAB and professional questions out of the personal student-sickness route.
mappings.truth_guardrail: Current CSN and Försäkringskassan primary guidance must carry material rules. Do not infer individual eligibility, SGI, benefit amount, diagnosis, certificate outcome or a universal deadline from free text or discovery signals.
mappings.privacy_guardrail: Public handoff and structured feedback may contain only focus=student_csn, topic=sickness, language and coarse study/work context. Never place raw story, diagnosis, medical note, exact sickness dates, course/results, income, employer identity, name or personnummer in URL or feedback.
